issues: The summary says Nephi “introduces” his record; that is a reasonable description, but not an explicit event beyond his statements about it.
The people of Jerusalem are established by the verse as the audience, but are not explicitly shown to be physically present in this particular scene.
The twelve others accompany the first figure in the vision, but their presence at the book-giving moment is not explicitly stated.
Lehi is explicitly reading, but the separate spoken dialogue reproduces the words read; the verse does not clarify whether to stage them as audible speech.
